svg.title: Supplier–Buyer Agent Collaboration connectivity
svg.desc: Default: local browser and Python server on your own computer at localhost:8000. Optional: host the same UI and backend in App Service with its own private endpoint. APIM Internal with Credential Manager, private Foundry and Studio A2A are the proposed cloud topology, not completed migration evidence.

text.tspan: Run the app on your own computer | App Service hosting is optional
Move this same UI + backend to Azure
ACR registry and data endpoint zone
Private names resolve to PE addresses
Reuse private DNS and network access
ADDITIONAL PRIVATE ENDPOINTS / APP SERVICE ATTACHMENT IS OPTIONAL
IDENTITY EXCHANGE / SUPPLEMENTS STAGE 3, NOT A SECOND BUSINESS ROUTE
Returns to the numbered A2A route
OPERATOR AND DEPLOYMENT / SEPARATE FROM THE RUNTIME REQUEST
Build and publish from private network
APIM does not run publication jobs
Not required for the main runtime
Scoped private DNS for the operator
APIM Internal / broker cutover and optional App Service hosting require acceptance. Existing resources remain unchanged.
Logical product labels only. Responses return through the same chain. Azure private access does not make Copilot Studio or Entra private.
